items.label: A
items.text: Ambulance; provides basic life support and patient transport.

items.label: ALS
items.text: Advanced life support; paramedic chase vehicle, often an SUV

items.label: AT
items.text: Aerial tower; ladder apparatus with a bucket or work platform.

items.label: CP
items.text: Command post; a vehicle equipped to support incident command during major emergencies.

items.label: M
items.text: Medic unit; provides advanced life support and patient transport.

items.label: MAU
items.text: Mobile air unit; supplies and refills firefighters’ breathing-air cylinders.

items.label: RE
items.text: Rescue engine; a firefighting engine that also carries vehicle-extrication equipment.

items.label: REHAB
items.text: Rehabilitation unit; a support vehicle that helps firefighters rest, rehydrate, cool down or warm up, and receive medical monitoring at an incident.

items.label: RS
items.text: Rescue squad; carries specialized equipment for heavy rescue and vehicle extrication.

items.label: T
items.text: Truck; ladder apparatus without a bucket or work platform.

items.label: W
items.text: Tanker; carries large quantities of water to supply firefighting operations.
